Subject: Discovery recap + next step: demo slot and security contact

Hi Elena / Tom —

Thanks again for taking time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call:  

- Key goals: reduce query latency for patient-facing search, enforce data isolation per tenant, and evaluate on-prem inference options.
- Success metric: <20ms 95th percentile for triage routing at 500rps in pilot.

Recommended next step: 45-minute technical deep dive + sandbox demo where we validate integration points (SSO, data access patterns, KV caching). I have the following windows available next week:

  * Tue 4/27 10:00–10:45 ET
  * Wed 4/28 14:00–14:45 ET
  * Thu 4/29 09:00–09:45 ET

Could you confirm which of the above works or propose two alternative windows? Also, to make the session productive, please loop in the person who owns security (CISO or security engineering) and someone from procurement who will own contracting/POs.

Attached: discovery-notes.pdf (high-level notes). I can also send a short demo agenda and a mutual action plan draft once we lock a time.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
